scope: Extend the existing generated LAYOUT/NOD ASCII and Binary DXF round-trip with the exact semantic-owner and local serializer-order checks identified by the refined PAR-20/7G.3 plan.

changes: The exported LAYOUT graph now asserts each re-imported LAYOUT's parentHandle equals the exact ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary handle.
